messages:
Ava: Heads-up: opened docs PR (GH #768) with SDK migration snippets and a small TOC tweak. Vercel preview is stuck in 'building' for ~18m. Can reviewers proceed without the preview?

Priya: I can review the markdown and code examples. The migration guide includes inline Rust and Python snippets, so please ensure formatting doesn't get mangled by the renderer.

vercel-bot: Vercel deployment started for PR #768 at 2026-03-21 15:10 UTC — status: building.

Ava: The PR edits add a new example for the client initializer and a short note about quantized-model flags. The visual diff matters only for the admonition styling and the TOC update.

Nico: If Vercel is flaky, do the usual: 1) run mkdocs locally to validate anchors, 2) generate a small static build and attach it to the PR, 3) leave an explicit :eyes: if you can't run it. I can also run a quick spot-check.

Ava: I'll attach a site artifact. Commands I used locally: 
```
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs build -d snapshot_site
tar -czf docs_snapshot_768.tgz snapshot_site
```
Attaching docs_snapshot_768.tgz to GH comment.

Priya: Nice. Running `mkdocs serve` now to check the code blocks and the new anchor `#client-initializer`.

build-bot: CI: docs-lint passed. Unit tests unrelated to docs passed.

Priya: The code fences look good. One nit in the Rust example: change `Client::new()` to `Client::from_env()` per the migration note. Pushed fix.

Ava: Fixed. Any blockers for merging during the 16:00 merge window? Vercel might still not produce a preview by then.

Nico: I'd be comfortable with merging if both Priya and I sign off and the snapshot is attached. The TOC change is small and reversible, but we should call out the exact anchor ids in the PR description.

Priya: Approved. Left :+1: and mentioned the anchor check passed locally.

Nico: Approved as well. Leaving :eyes: and a short comment that I validated the snapshot.

Docs-CI: Vercel redeploy attempted by @Ava at 2026-03-21 15:45 UTC — status: failed (timeout). Error: network timeout uploading artifacts. Tagging eng-infra.

Ava: Ok merging is scheduled for the 16:00 slot per our normal merge-policy since two reviewers approved and snapshot is attached. I'll include the snapshot link in the release notes.

vercel-bot: Merge scheduled by @Ava for 16:00 UTC.

Ava: Merged at 16:00. If anyone sees TOC weirdness or anchor regressions, I'll revert and open a follow-up. Filing infra ticket INFRA-778 with the Vercel logs and the snapshot.

Nico: Thanks. This is a good pattern: attach a small static snapshot when preview infra is unreliable. Saves time for reviewers.

Priya: Agreed. Adding a short checklist to the docs CONTRIBUTING.md recommending snapshot attachments for PRs that touch TOC/anchors.

Ava: Will follow up with a short PR to CONTRIBUTING.md. Thanks all :tada:
